definitions.images: all image files in the split directory of the released split lists
definitions.paired: images having both a caption (.txt) and a cached text feature (.npy) in the authors' local copy at experiment time; these are the samples actually loaded by the training/evaluation dataloader
definitions.unpaired: images lacking caption or feature; skipped at load time

split_rule: Soybean: no official split exists; all text-paired samples pooled and split stratified 70/10/20 into TRAIN/VAL/TEST (seed 42). PlantDoc: the official test folder is used as TEST unchanged; the remaining images are split stratified 90/10 into TRAIN/VAL (seed 42). Split lists reflect the completed caption set (every listed image is text-paired).
